title: Étale local support above a component generic point
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $\eta\in Z$ be the generic point [def-sc-generic-point] of an irreducible component $C$ of $Z$ [def-weil-irreducible-components]. Let $v:W\to X$ be étale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and let $w\in W$ satisfy $v(w)=i(\eta)$. Put $A=\mathcal O_{X,i(\eta)}$, $B=\mathcal O_{W,w}$ and let $I=\ker(A\to\mathcal O_{Z,\eta})$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Write $P=Z\times_X\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-fibre-product], regarded as a closed subscheme of $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $\dim\mathcal O_{Z,\eta}=0$ and $\dim(B/IB)=0$, with Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Under $P\cong\operatorname{Spec}(B/IB)$, the underlying space of $P$ consists of a single point $t$, whose image in $\operatorname{Spec}B$ is its closed point $s=V(\mathfrak m_B)$. Thus $\{t\}$ is the only irreducible component of $P$ (no assertion of reducedness is made). Moreover $\dim B=\dim A$ and $\operatorname{codim}(\{s\},\operatorname{Spec}B)=\dim B$. Here codimension is the supremum of lengths of chains $Y=Y_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq Y_r$ of irreducible closed subsets of the ambient scheme.

proof.text: By [lem-sc-scheme-stalk-dimension-generalization-chains], the dimension of the stalk of $Z$ at $\eta$ is its coheight. If $y$ generalizes $\eta$, then $C=\overline{\{\eta\}}\subseteq\overline{\{y\}}$. Maximality of the component [def-weil-irreducible-components] gives the reverse containment. Thus $\eta$ is maximal in the specialization order, its coheight is zero, and $\dim\mathcal O_{Z,\eta}=0.

Apply [lem-trf-finite-intersection-etale-stalk-model] to the constant one-member family $D_0=Z$, $i_0=i$, with $J=\{0\}$. The cone with point $Z$, base $i$, and identity projection is limiting: every cone factors uniquely through its sole projection. Choose an affine neighbourhood of $i(\eta)$. The proved source-library lemma Scheme.Hom.ker_stalkMap identifies the extended section ideal with the kernel of the actual stalk map; it is the usual closed-immersion quotient calculation [def-weil-closed-immersion] and [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization]. The model gives the isomorphism $P\cong\operatorname{Spec}(B/IB)$ over $\operatorname{Spec}B$, nonzero local $B/IB$, a point $p$ of $Z\times_XW$ over $w$ and $\eta$, and a ring isomorphism $B/IB\cong\mathcal O_{Z\times_XW,p}$. The transport in the model is the inverse of the stalk-congruence isomorphism; this is exactly the homomorphism defining genericComponentEtaleLocalIdeal.

For any etale morphism $e:V\to U$ at a point $v$, choose affine opens around $e(v)$ and $v$ with the source open mapping to the target open. The chart homomorphism is etale by [def-weil-etale-morphism] and [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine]. The canonical arrowStalkMapIso identifies the two stalks with the localizations of the section rings at their primes [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization]. The contraction formula for these primes and [lem-sc-etale-local-dimension] give equality of stalk dimensions. Apply this to $W\to X$ to obtain $\dim B=\dim A$. This uses finite presentation only on the affine chart homomorphism.

source.place: Tag 07QP on affine charts; schemes.tex Tag 01HV

proof.text: The first projection $Z\times_XW\to Z$ is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change]. Apply the affine-chart stalk dimension argument of step 3 to this projection at $p$. Since it maps to $\eta$, step 1 and the ring isomorphism supplied in step 2 give $\dim(B/IB)=\dim\mathcal O_{Z\times_XW,p}=\dim\mathcal O_{Z,\eta}=0$. Thus a separate quotient-chart tensor and localization calculation is unnecessary.

A nonzero local ring of dimension zero has only its maximal prime [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]: any strictly smaller prime would give a chain of length one. Mathlib packages this as PrimeSpectrum.unique_of_ringKrullDimLE_zero. Pull its closed point back along $P\cong\operatorname{Spec}(B/IB)$ to get $t$. Every point equals $t$. The quotient homomorphism is local by [lem-weil-pbc-quotient-local-structure], so the isomorphism over $\operatorname{Spec}B$ sends $t$ to the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}B$. Finally, every subset is contained in $\{t\}$; maximality of an irreducible component and irreducibility of a singleton show directly that the component set is $\{\{t\}\}$ [def-weil-irreducible-components].

source.place: Tag 0BA9; algebra.tex Tag 00CT; elementary prime-chain argument

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-scheme-stalk-dimension-generalization-chains] at the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}B$. The canonical stalkClosedPointIso identifies this stalk with the local ring $B$ itself: localization at its maximal ideal inverts only units [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization]. Ring isomorphisms preserve Krull dimension, giving the last coheight equality.

lean.statement: theorem genericComponent_etale_local_support {X Z W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (η : Z) (C : Set Z) (hC : C ∈ irreducibleComponents Z) (hη : IsGenericPoint η C) (v : W ⟶ X) [Etale v] (w : W) (hw : v w = i η) : ringKrullDim (Z.presheaf.stalk η) = 0 ∧ ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk w ⧸ genericComponentEtaleLocalIdeal i η v w hw) = 0 ∧ (∃ e : pullback i (W.fromSpecStalk w ≫ v) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (W.presheaf.stalk w ⧸ genericComponentEtaleLocalIdeal i η v w hw)), e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (genericComponentEtaleLocalIdeal i η v w hw))) = pullback.snd i (W.fromSpecStalk w ≫ v) ∧ ∃ t : (pullback i (W.fromSpecStalk w ≫ v) : Scheme.{u}), (∀ p : (pullback i (W.fromSpecStalk w ≫ v) : Scheme.{u}), p = t) ∧ (pullback.snd i (W.fromSpecStalk w ≫ v)) t = IsLocalRing.closedPoint (W.presheaf.stalk w) ∧ irreducibleComponents (pullback i (W.fromSpecStalk w ≫ v) : Scheme.{u}) = {{t}}) ∧ ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk w) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (i η)) ∧ (Order.coheight (@id (Spec (W.presheaf.stalk w)) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (W.presheaf.stalk w))) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk w)
